card.name: Noun stems just before an ending is added
card.fires_on: A noun stem (grant, quota, rash, garrison, abscess, marsh, subsid-) that is about to take an ending like -ed, -y, -ization, or a hyphenated compound. It appears in general web text and some medical text.

modes.label: Noun before hyphen
modes.description: A noun placed before a hyphen to form a compound modifier.
modes.example: there will be no state-funded,<< grant>>-aided energy efficiency programmes.

modes.label: Stem before ending
modes.description: The first part of a word is split, and the rest, such as -ed, -y, or -ies, follows.
modes.example: the castle would be g<<arrison>>ed by the lord's tenantry,

modes.label: Policy or quota nouns
modes.description: Nouns about quotas, subsidies, or grants in policy text.
modes.example: The Supreme Court decided that the University's<< quota>> system for admitting minorities was far too rigid
